resources.string: \"Write with AI\" buttons (write, summarize, classify, rewrite, extract, suggest) send data only when tapped. Short answers send nothing when on-device AI is available; otherwise they send recent records and the text being entered (up to 4KB). Long-answer buttons always send up to 16KB. In a shared app, only records you added are used.

The \"AI chat\" part sends the latest turns of your own conversation saved in that app (up to 20 turns, 16KB) each time you send a message. If the app sets a reference list, your own latest records from it (up to 20, 8KB) are also sent. A photo is sent only when you tap a \"photo\" AI button: one downscaled image (JPEG, long edge up to 1024 pixels). Audio and video are never sent.
Destination: Anthropic, PBC (USA), via Tailor It\'s server (Google Cloud). It is used only to build your app, write a button\'s text or reply in a chat.
When you build or edit an app, the following is sent to Anthropic\'s AI (Claude).
The current app design (screens, fields, app name, etc.)
What you said or typed (transcribed on this device; audio itself is never sent)
When you build or edit an app, the contents of your records (numbers, notes, photos, etc.) are not sent.
We\'ve updated what is sent to the AI. Please review it again.
Without consent you can still view and record in your apps; only AI features are unavailable. You can withdraw consent in Settings at any time (data already sent cannot be recalled).

Once a day, sends whether on-device AI is available (unsupported device, turned off, or preparing) and how many times AI buttons could not answer, per button type (summarize, classify, etc.). Your user ID, the text you typed, and your records are not sent.
You can also say “Undo”. Say “Another app: …” to build a new app.

When the app crashes, where it crashed (the location in the code), your device model, OS, app version and user ID are sent to Google\'s Firebase Crashlytics and used to fix bugs. What you say, your records and the contents of your apps are never sent.
This app uses the open source software listed above.

When you build or edit an app, what you said, the conversation and the app design are sent to Anthropic\'s AI (the contents of your records are not). \"Write with AI\" buttons send data only when tapped (short answers up to 4KB, only if on-device AI is unavailable; long answers always up to 16KB). The \"AI chat\" part sends the latest conversation (up to 20 turns, 16KB) and, if set, your own reference records (up to 20, 8KB), and a photo button sends one downscaled photo. If you withdraw consent, AI features are disabled (viewing and recording still work). Data already sent cannot be recalled.
The app you made goes back to the voice screen only. Data on the server is not deleted.
